verses.text: Of David. Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.

segments.text: Of David. Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.

verses.text: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.

segments.text: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.

verses.text: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers; say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”

segments.text: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers; say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”

verses.text: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.

segments.text: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.

verses.text: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.

segments.text: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.

verses.text: May their path be dark and slick, as the angel of the LORD pursues.

segments.text: May their path be dark and slick, as the angel of the LORD pursues.

verses.text: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.

segments.text: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.

verses.text: May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.

segments.text: May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.

verses.text: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation.

segments.text: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation.

verses.text: All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”

segments.text: All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”

verses.text: Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.

segments.text: Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.

verses.text: They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.

segments.text: They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.

verses.text: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.

segments.text: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.

verses.text: I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.

segments.text: I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.

verses.text: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.

segments.text: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.

verses.text: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.

segments.text: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.

verses.text: How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.

segments.text: How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.

verses.text: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.

segments.text: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.

verses.text: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.

segments.text: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.

verses.text: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.

segments.text: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.

verses.text: They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”

segments.text: They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”

verses.text: O LORD, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.

segments.text: O LORD, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.

verses.text: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!

segments.text: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!

verses.text: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.

segments.text: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.

verses.text: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”

segments.text: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”

verses.text: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.

segments.text: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.

verses.text: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”

segments.text: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”

verses.text: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.

segments.text: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.
